arguments.query: small business owner needs simple written policy or FAQ document created

results.text: A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
A small producer describes repeated shortages of inexpensive components alongside excess stock of rarely used parts.
A small workshop asks peers how they track changing supplier prices and lead times for recurring materials.
A specialty seller has duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across several public listings.
A small professional practice is publicly comparing several software subscriptions but lacks a consistent cost and feature analysis.

arguments.scope: Create a single clear "Standard Service" FAQ/policy document for the repair business that resolves the conflicting public descriptions: it will list exactly what the standard service includes/excludes, common add-ons, and answers to the top recurring customer questions, delivered as one organized document (Markdown/PDF-ready text).
